audit_items.proof_trace: Each investor is gated by `position.hasSettled` checked in `_verifyCanClaimTokenAllocation` (LegionAbstractSale.sol:739), ensuring at most one vesting deployment per investor. The factory deploys via `LibClone.clone()` (CREATE opcode), which produces a fresh, nonce-determined address on every invocation — no two calls can return the same address. When `amountToBeVested == 0` no contract is deployed at all, which is by design and does not constitute shared vesting.
